description: Three guards the funnel depends on: secrets never reach a transcript, a green suite cannot be faked, and the pull request body stays under the budget the skill asks for and nobody checked. All three run in one interpreter through hooks/guards.py, which prefilters by substring before importing any of them: registered separately they spent three interpreter startups, measured at 13 ms each, on every Bash call to answer no. The em dash hook rides the same dispatcher but stays opt-in behind KIT_NO_EM_DASH, because it is a house style rather than a correctness property.
